tasks.query: A parameterless HTTP authentication challenge should serialize without trailing whitespace so strict downstream HTTP parsers accept the response header.

The interactive debugger should still render the original traceback when source lines for a failing frame are unavailable or shorter than the reported line number, rather than crashing while rendering the error page.

Multipart file parsing must preserve payload bytes when a transport chunk boundary splits the final carriage-return and line-feed before the multipart boundary, instead of leaking a delimiter byte into the uploaded file.
Creating an ad-hoc development TLS context should close temporary certificate and key file handles promptly so newer Python runtimes do not report leaked temporary resources.
A router that mounts a grouped set of routes at the root should return a normal missing-route response for an undefined path instead of entering an endless route-matching loop.
When a wrapped HTTP response writer mirrors output to a secondary writer, streaming data from a reader should count each byte exactly once in the recorded response size.
Wrapping an HTTP response writer should preserve support for setting a write deadline when the underlying server connection supports that capability.

Registering a handler function with a route pattern that includes an HTTP method should interpret the method prefix consistently with the generic handler registration API instead of treating it as part of the path and panicking.
Multipart response part names and filenames containing quotes or backslashes must remain inside a single content-disposition parameter instead of being able to alter the serialized header structure.

An optional request-extractor field should become absent only when the extractor reports no value; malformed input should preserve the extractor's rejection instead of silently turning the error into an empty optional value.
A HEAD response should not advertise a zero content length merely because its body is omitted; when the corresponding GET length is unknown, the content-length header should be left out.
A derived request type that delegates extraction through another extractor should expose that extractor's rejection type rather than falling back to a generic response rejection.

Serializing a collection declared with an upper-bounded wildcard should preserve fields introduced by each element's actual runtime subclass instead of serializing only the declared base-class fields.
Two numeric JSON primitive values that compare equal after parsing an integer through a lazy numeric representation must also produce equal hash codes.

Deserializing an array-encoded map entry whose key is JSON null should fail through the library's documented parse-exception family instead of leaking a raw null-pointer exception from the backing map.
Integer and long deserialization should not silently accept non-ASCII Unicode decimal digits as ordinary JSON numeric values, including when strict parsing is enabled.
When caller cancellation passes through a timeout strategy, the cancellation exception observed by the caller should identify the original caller token rather than an internal linked timeout token.

Completing a scheduled resilience task must not execute arbitrary caller continuations inline on the executor's single processing thread, where a blocking continuation can deadlock later state transitions.
A timeout exception produced after a configured five-second timeout should report the configured timeout duration rather than an unrelated negative one-millisecond duration.
A custom telemetry severity policy should be honored for resilience-pipeline start and completion events instead of those events ignoring the configured severity override.
A cacheable QUERY request with a matching entity tag should be considered fresh and produce a not-modified response just as conditional GET and HEAD requests do.
Repeated query parameters should remain an array even when more than twenty values are supplied, rather than changing shape into an object with numeric keys.
A query parameter written with array syntax and a single value should be parsed as an array consistently in hosted environments rather than leaving the brackets in the parameter name.
Default application error logging should preserve nested causes and other useful error-object metadata instead of reducing the logged value to only its stack string.
